BANGLAORE FOR THE ALLEGED OFFENCES PUNISHABLE UNDER SECTIONS 498A, 323, 504, 506 READ WITH SECTION 34 OF IPC AND SECTIONS 3, 4 OF D.P. ACT.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

The petitioner has filed this petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. for quashing the criminal proceedings in C.C. No.54786/2020 on the file of 29th Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate,
Bengaluru and charge sheeted for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
2.
Heard learned counsel for petitioner-accused Nos.1 to 3 and the learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent-State.

sentences.text: The case of petitioners is that after fling of the complaint by respondent No.2-complainant,
petitioner

No.1 filed divorce case against respondent No.2-complainant before the Family Court at Puri, Odisha, where the respondent- complainant filed an affidavit accepting for compromise by receiving Rs.7.00 lakhs as alimony.
Consequently, the Family Court granted the decree of divorce.
In the said affidavit, respondent No.2-complainant agreed for quashing of criminal proceedings against the petitioners.
4. Neither respondent No.2-complainant nor the learned counsel for respondent No.2-complainant is present.
5. Admittedly, the parties hail from Puri, Odisha.

It is also admitted that divorce is granted by the Family Court at Odisha on the compromise held between petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 before the said Court, wherein respondent No.2-complainant has filed an affidavit of undertaking that she will take step/co-operate to withdraw the present proceedings before this Court.

In view of that fact that respondent No.2- complainant has remained absent and she hails from Odisha, this Court cannot expect her to come and agree or give consent for withdrawal of the present proceedings.
6. Therefore, the criminal petition is allowed.

Criminal proceedings against the petitioners in C.C.
No.54786/2020 on the file of 29th Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru is hereby quashed.
Pending I.As., if any, stands disposed of.

Sd/-
